bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches and small clutches up to about 4.5 x 6.5 inches are allowed. Large bags and purses, coolers and umbrellas are not permitted.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in
Small clutch bags up to 4.5 x 6.5 in
bagPolicy.quote: Clear Plastic, Vinyl, or PVC Bags (Maximum Size: 12”x6”x12”)

parking.summary: Parking at SOMA is free. Don't park on neighborhood streets or block driveways nearby, and head straight to the line once you park.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by SOMA. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Craft beer is sold at every event for guests 21 and over with ID. The main lobby soda bar has soft drinks, water and snacks.
concessions.quote: Visit our main lobby soda bar that features soft drinks, water & snacks.

accessibility.summary: SOMA has a limited number of spaces for guests with mobility issues. Check in at the box office for help, or ask a SOMA team member before you arrive.
accessibility.quote: SOMA has a limited number of special space for persons with mobility issues.

reEntry.summary: SOMA has a no re-entry policy for all events, so once you leave you can't come back in.
reEntry.quote: SOMA has a “No Re-Entry” policy for all events

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Thursdays from 5:30 to 7:30 pm and on event days starting at 4 pm, and sells tickets in person only. Will call is at the box office and opens one hour before doors. The person named on the account must be there with photo ID and the card used to buy the tickets.
ticketPickup.quote: Tickets may be picked up beginning one hour prior to the doors opening.

gates.summary: Door and show times are listed online and on your ticket. Once you park, go straight to the line.
gates.quote: Door and show times will be listed online or on your tickets.
